svg.title: Phytos architecture (prototype, Oct 2026)
svg.desc: Components of the Phytos crop-health early-warning prototype grouped into clients, the Cloud Run API, AI and knowledge, data and analytics, alerts and delivery, external sources and operator tools. Each box is marked working, hackathon or future. Numbered connectors 1 to 6 are the main flows described in docs/architecture.md.
svg.text: Crop-health early warning for Zambia. GreenCode Hackathon, Lusaka, 30 Oct to 1 Nov 2026.
GCP project crop-watch01; infrastructure keeps the cropwatch resource names.

svg.text: tools/ and infra/, run by hand
Regions: default europe-west1 (Cloud Run, Firestore, Storage, BigQuery, Pub/Sub). Gemini runs on the eu multi-region endpoint. The RAG Engine corpus is in europe-west4.
Simulated data is always labelled DEMO. Only public documents and query text go to the RAG Engine corpus.
